capabilities: Record expenses, income, refunds, transfers and debt payments with categories, tags and merchants
Plan monthly budgets per subcategory and compare against spending
Track cash, credit card, loan and investing accounts plus hand-valued assets
Compute net worth over time with breakdown and pie charts
Validate and repair damaged or inconsistent finance notes
extras: Status is early development and not yet released; installation is manual (clone and build). Amounts are stored as integer cents and are USD only. The plugin manages its notes under a Nestegg/ folder and warns against editing them by hand; Stock Valuations integration is out of scope for v1.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track money, so budgeting and net worth normally require a separate finance app outside the vault.
summary: Personal finance tracker that manages transactions, budgets, accounts, assets and net worth in Markdown notes inside the vault.
